description: §42.2.3 / §63.5 — the soft-deprecated in-place presence guard: a single-name `given name :> { … }`, a multi-name `given name, age :> { … }` (one name absent, so the body is skipped) and `given empty :> { … }` over the defined value "" (present, §42.1.1). Each guard surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (Warning; 3 here) and runs identically to its `x is given` rewrite — the twin is condition/given-presence-canonical-twin, which reaches the same state. The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §42.2.3 (S462) — the in-place presence guard is SOFT-DEPRECATED: it parses, lowers and runs as before (the body runs only when every listed name is not `not`; `""` is present, §42.1.1) and every guard surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED. §63.5 — during the window the W-code is a conformance-required code and the deprecated form's runtime is identical to the canonical form's. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
